name: evalexpr_rhai
description: Evaluate a [Rhai](https://rhai.rs/) expression or full script and return the result as a DuckDB `UNION` of `ok` (the JSON-encoded result on success) or `error` (the error message on failure). With one argument, the script runs with no per-row context. With two arguments, the second is a `JSON` object exposed inside the script as `context.<field>` — the standard pattern for per-row evaluation. Constant expressions are parsed and cached the first time they're seen, so repeat evaluations skip the parse step.

examples.code:
SELECT name,
       evalexpr_rhai('context.salary > 100000',
                     { 'salary': salary }).ok AS high_earner
FROM employees;
